hookText: POV: I caught the new maid in the quiet corridor...
voiceoverScript: Ah, my candle flickers in the draft, casting shadows that play across my face. I see her, a servant in the hall, her eyes wide with fear. My tallow candle, my only light, I must be careful. Who knows what secrets she carries? Tonight, in our London manor, there's more than meets the eye.
